review_scope: Read-only review of new run_eval.py/evaluation.py, source-derivation interface, and real reference metadata
findings: Source guard requires a genuine successful full100 triple-direct run, the exact archived protocol/package, matching environment/backend, and complete600-row history.
Best is independently recovered as the first E4M3 maximum; epoch100 stays fixed; no selection on new post-hoc scores.
Six direct MX export files are verified against size, report SHA256 and sidecar before weights_only tensor load; provenance ties them to the selected checkpoint.
FP32 training checkpoints and their optimizer state are not opened; derived paths use only archived source codes/scales and shared auxiliary state.
Five derived files are saved, checksummed and reloaded before frozen model reconstruction; bit routes preserve source scales and do not call a quantizer or G(W).
All paths select the target precision BN bank and use eval/no_grad/frozen parameters; full model/BN state digests are checked before and after inference.
Only test split is loaded; test file hash, original preprocessing, labels and complete ordered sample coverage are checked.
Every path sees each same batch; NPZ arrays and metrics derive from the same stored logits/topk predictions/labels; paired net changes are asserted.
Historical direct accuracy differences generate explicit warnings and are not corrected; newly reevaluated direct modes remain comparison baselines.
Original report/export/sidecar and test-data hashes are rechecked; new timestamped output is outside original reference directory.
No train/run/resume/download/partial-dataset CLI route exists; no optimizer/backward or BN recalibration occurs in evaluate.
Low truncation accuracy is accepted as a measured result; finite-state, source, scale or provenance inconsistency causes FAIL.
evidence_limits: The real attachment contains reports and CSVs, not source model export tensors or SVHN arrays; real post-hoc outputs were not recomputed here.
This review is separate from the bounded synthetic runner/evaluator integration tests performed by the parent/test agent.
Exact CUDA repeatability is not guaranteed under the preserved backend; the code records any historical count differences.
